row.notes: For every section descriptor in vehicle_asset+0x30..+0x38 (stride 0x40): looks the section node up by name in the team VTF document (asset+0x10, doc vt+0x20); when the car is equal-performance (car+0x12c != 0) and the asset has a base asset ([asset+0x48]+0x28) it uses the base VTF's section instead and sets [car+0xe0]+0x1040 = 1. Then Car_Systems_FindOrCreate(systems, node, desc) creates the system (first time) and calls its Read on the node. Logs 'Car is using %s.' (VEHICLE_ASSETS). Called at car create (Car_Chassis_Build 0x1446296e5) and on reset (Car_Systems_Reset_Body 0x1555bdf96): every reset re-reads all VTF sections Runtime 2026-10-28 (T120 pass): 64 calls in a Grand Prix: 21 at create (return 0x1446296ea), 2 x 20 from the all-vehicles reset (0x14f82453a) during loading, 3 from the per-vehicle reset of id 19 (0x142f44d0d via the controller-change body 0x1519eb3e9).
